Here are a few tips on the best time to visit Nan, Fiji:

1. Dry Season (May to October) - This is generally considered the best time to visit Nan, Fiji. The weather is dry, sunny, and cooler, making it ideal for outdoor activities like beach visits, snorkeling, and hiking. Temperatures typically range from 75-85°F.

2. Shoulder Seasons (April-May, October-November) - These transitional periods can also be good times to visit. You'll find lower prices on accommodation and flights, and slightly fewer crowds compared to peak season.

3. Wet Season (November to April) - The weather is more humid and rainy during this time. However, you may find some good deals on travel packages. This can be a good option if you don't mind some rainy days.

The best time largely depends on your interests and priorities. The dry season offers the most ideal beach weather, while the wet season may be better for discounted travel and fewer tourists. Many travelers prefer the shoulder seasons to strike a balance between weather, crowds, and costs. Overall, Nan is a beautiful destination to visit year-round, so it comes down to your personal preferences.
